name: grovers-algorithm
description: Use this skill when the user says 'Grover', 'Grover search', 'amplitude amplification', 'quantum unstructured search', 'oracle and diffuser', 'how many Grover iterations', 'quadratic speedup', 'Grover attack on AES'. Explains Grover's algorithm and amplitude amplification, computes the optimal iteration count, implements oracle + diffuser in Qiskit, and assesses realistic speedups (including key search). Do NOT use for: Shor's factoring (quantum-computing/shors-algorithm), general algorithm survey (quantum-computing/quantum-algorithms), or Qiskit setup questions (quantum-computing/qiskit-framework).
